newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia November inflation 0.57 pct - report.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia November inflation 0.57 pct - report.

text.p: Indonesia's Finance Ministry said on Monday month-on-month inflation in November was 0.57 percent, the official Antara news agency reported.
Antara quoted a statement from the ministry as saying rises in food prices had provided the largest contribution to the increase.
Indonesia's monthly inflation in October was 0.41 percent and 0.42 percent in November 1995.
The figure gave a year-on-year inflation rate of 6.71 percent.
